results.generatedSql: SELECT "Ativo".id, "Ativo".codigo, "Ativo".nome, "Ativo".status FROM "Ativo" JOIN "Empresa" ON "Ativo"."empresaId" = "Empresa".id WHERE "Empresa".codigo = 'alpha-brazilian' AND "Ativo".ativo = true AND "Ativo".status IN ('PARADO','EM_MANUTENCAO','AGUARDANDO_PECA') LIMIT 100;

SELECT os.status, COUNT(*) AS quantidade
FROM "OrdemServico" os
JOIN "Empresa" e ON os."empresaId" = e.id
WHERE e.codigo = 'alpha-brazilian'
  AND os.status IN ('ABERTA', 'EM_EXECUCAO', 'AGUARDANDO_PECA')
GROUP BY os.status
LIMIT 100;

SELECT "Ativo".id, "Ativo".codigo, "Ativo".nome, COUNT(*) AS num_corr
FROM "OrdemServico"
JOIN "Ativo" ON "OrdemServico"."ativoId" = "Ativo".id
JOIN "Empresa" ON "Ativo"."empresaId" = "Empresa".id
WHERE "Empresa".codigo = 'alpha-brazilian'
  AND "OrdemServico".tipo = 'CORRETIVA'
GROUP BY "Ativo".id, "Ativo".codigo, "Ativo".nome
ORDER BY num_corr DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT "Material".id, "Material".codigo, "Material".nome, "Material".estoqueAtual, "Material".estoqueMinimo FROM "Material" JOIN "Empresa" ON "Material"."empresaId" = "Empresa".id WHERE "Empresa".codigo = 'alpha-international' AND "Material".estoqueAtual <= "Material".estoqueMinimo LIMIT 100;

SELECT "OrdemServico".id, "OrdemServico".numero, "OrdemServico".titulo, "OrdemServico".status, "OrdemServico".prazoEm FROM "OrdemServico" JOIN "Empresa" ON "OrdemServico"."empresaId" = "Empresa".id WHERE "Empresa".codigo = 'alpha-brazilian' AND "OrdemServico".status IN ('ABERTA','EM_EXECUCAO','AGUARDANDO_PECA') AND "OrdemServico".prazoEm < '2026-10-27T12:00:00Z' LIMIT 100;

SELECT SUM("custoTotal") AS total_custo FROM "OrdemServico" os JOIN "Empresa" e ON os."empresaId" = e.id WHERE e.codigo = 'alpha-brazilian' AND os.status IN ('ABERTA','EM_EXECUCAO','AGUARDANDO_PECA') AND os."abertaEm" >= '2026-08-01' AND os."abertaEm" < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 100;

SELECT \"Ativo\".codigo, \"Ativo\".nome, AVG(\"ParadaAtivo\".\"duracaoMinutos\") AS avg_duracao FROM \"ParadaAtivo\" JOIN \"Ativo\" ON \"ParadaAtivo\".\"ativoId\" = \"Ativo\".id JOIN \"Empresa\" ON \"Ativo\".\"empresaId\" = \"Empresa\".id WHERE \"ParadaAtivo\".\"status\" = 'ENCERRADA' AND \"Empresa\".\"codigo\" = 'alpha-international' GROUP BY \"Ativo\".id, \"Ativo\".codigo, \"Ativo\".nome ORDER BY avg_duracao DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.nome FROM "Material" m JOIN "OrdemServicoMaterial" osm ON m.id = osm."materialId" JOIN "OrdemServico" os ON osm."ordemServicoId" = os.id JOIN "Empresa" e ON os."empresaId" = e.id WHERE e.codigo = 'alpha-brazilian' AND os.status = 'AGUARDANDO_PECA' LIMIT 100;
